title: Signal
description: One row of FAERS disproportionality evidence for an ingredient on a risk dimension, within an age band and sex (NOMI-053). IC025 above 0 counts as a signal.

event_group.description: MedDRA event group behind the dimension, e.g. 'hepatic_disorders'.

age_band.description: Patient age band in years. 'all' is the unstratified total.

sex.description: Patient sex as reported. 'all' is the unstratified total.

ic025.description: Lower end of the 95% credibility interval for IC.

report_count.description: Reports with both the ingredient and the event group (observed).

expected_count.description: Reports expected if ingredient and event were unrelated.
